integrity: The all-parameter argument is symbolic. The standalone finite-prime enumerator is a corroborating computation, not proof of the asymptotic.
scientific_limitations: Odd prime powers only; fixed-field large-dimension expansion; all-dimension monotonicity not claimed. Historical priority not exhaustive, especially inaccessible Hodges (1955).
title: Odd-characteristic Veronese projections: exact norms and parity-dependent finite-size bias
